title: Completed OKR Alignment Matrix Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed OKR Alignment Matrix artifact data payloads (PMO-00.06).

strategic_cycle_and_horizon.description: The corporate planning cycle, fiscal year, and strategic review cadence governing the OKR alignment matrix.

enterprise_strategic_objective.description: The overarching corporate priority or strategic theme this initiative directly advances.

portfolio_investment_category.description: The investment classification (Strategic Growth, Operational Resilience, Transformative Innovation, or Mandatory Compliance).

target_key_result_id_and_metric.description: The specific measurable Key Result identifier and target performance metric defined by executive leadership.

project_deliverable_contribution.description: The tangible product capability, system feature, or project milestone directly contributing to Key Result fulfillment.

leading_vs_lagging_indicator.description: Classification whether the contribution measure provides immediate early progress signals (leading) or final outcome confirmation (lagging).

quarterly_confidence_score.description: Current subjective confidence rating (0.0 to 1.0) of achieving the Key Result given project execution trajectory.

confidence_variance_rationale.description: Root-cause explanation for any score degradation or positive acceleration relative to the previous cycle baseline.

strategic_pivot_recommendation.description: Mandated strategic intervention, scope adjustment, or resource reallocation if confidence drops below target threshold.
